shortDescription: Raiffeisen Bank International VIE:RBI said on Tuesday a Vienna court has issued a default judgment against European Union-sanctioned Russian firm Rasperia, ordering it to pay damages of about €3.15 billion ($3.60 billion).($1 = 0.8746 euros)
